title: IVG Intense Salts Spearmint 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Spearmint offers a cool and aromatic mint profile that’s lighter and sweeter than traditional Menthol. The flavour is smooth and refreshing, delivering a clean Spearmint taste that’s easy to enjoy throughout the day. Balanced at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt ensures consistent flavour delivery, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Spearmint is best suited to mouth-to-lung (MTL) devices including pod kits, vape pens and starter systems. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Spearmint provides a straightforward mint option with a softer edge.
